days.title: Stop Over-Explaining Your Boundaries — Do This Instead
days.tiktok_text: Over-explaining is just asking for permission in disguise. You don't need the paragraph. Say It Softly is linked in my bio. Reply with one word you wish you said more often. #boundaries #healingjourney #softlife #selfrespect

days.facebook_text: Short and kind is still enough — you don't owe anyone an essay for your limit. Say It Softly is linked in my bio. Reply with one word you wish you could say more often. We read every one. #boundaries #softlife #healingjourney
